title: Contrastive belief-update measurement of reward-seeking on public Qwen2.5 models
description: The paper's contrastive-SDF measurement and all its controls port cleanly to Qwen2.5-7B/14B, but the reported grader-following effects were not observed: at 7B the implanted authority-preference beliefs fail to bind at behavior-preserving training doses, and at 14B — with beliefs bound and behavior intact — style gaps equal the non-grader control, leaving only a weak grader-ward honesty-axis signal (+6.9/+8.2 nats on both seeds).
